name: refactor_rust_extract_discount_rule
description: Consolidates duplicated quantity-discount tier logic from two modules into one shared function
prompts: The modules src/checkout.rs and src/quote.rs contain the SAME inline quantity-discount tier logic: qty >= 100 -> 20, qty >= 50 -> 10, qty >= 10 -> 5, else 0. Remove the duplication: create a new module src/discount.rs defining `pub fn percent_for(qty: u32) -> u32` implementing exactly that tier rule, declare it in src/lib.rs (add `pub mod discount;`), and rewrite BOTH `checkout::final_price` and `quote::discount_percent` to call `crate::discount::percent_for` instead of their inline match. Do not change observable behavior: `quote::discount_percent(qty)` returns the same percents, and `checkout::final_price(unit_cents, qty)` still returns gross minus gross*percent/100. Neither module should keep its own copy of the tier thresholds.

setup_files.src/lib.rs:
pub mod checkout;
pub mod quote;
